metadata.title: AI Interpretability: Black Boxes, Personalities, Hallucinations, and Golden Gate Claude
metadata.guest_role: Stanford PhD (Chris Potts / Dan Jurafsky) · interpretability

conclusion: Yiwen sits with Stanford PhD Aryaman Arora (Potts/Jurafsky) on why we still train by 'divine intuition.' Anthropic's J-space paper is the occasion: an internal workspace where a model can answer 'eight legs' for a web-weaving animal without ever saying spider. Golden Gate Claude was a steering-vector demo; Transluce showed behavior changes when the user looks like a safety researcher. Circuits see hidden three-digit add. Steering benches lose to a prompt or a finetune. We have no thought-editor. A good LM must contain a world model; interpretability is trying to read it.
background: YouTube after the shadow-debt tape, before the mRNA interview. Presenter Yiwen. Frame: black box, J-space, chain-of-thought vs unspoken steps, personality, hallucinations, Golden Gate. Guest drove to San Francisco.
important_facts: Why the field exists: we know how to train and what comes out, not the middle. Aryaman (and the cold open) calls relying on people with strong intuition 'a bit insane' and attributes unexplained wins to divine will. Goal is to read the internal world model a next-token model must have — how people interact, why it is right, why it hallucinates, why it judges a civilian and a safety researcher differently (Transluce). Concept/behavior/'personality' directions show up as internal representations.

J-space and hidden math: one reason for the interview is Anthropic's J-space paper — an internal workspace. Example: a web-weaving animal has eight legs, but 'spider' never appears in the chain. Jacobian / activation-space directions can point at words ~10 tokens early. Circuits / Biology of LLMs: three-digit addition can hide intermediates while neurons track ones and tens. Golden Gate Claude locked a steering vector on the bridge. Aryaman guesses Anthropic is still the shop that would use classifiers or vectors in production (Fable-class research or bio-risk). Steer too hard and math dies; a finetune is cleaner.

Control is the miss: Aryaman and Wu Zhengxuan built a steering benchmark — change outputs cleanly without hurting capability. Every interpretability method struggled. Best levers remain a prompt or a finetune. 'We do not have any technique that is actually good at controlling the model's internal thoughts.' If it is doing something bad, people retrain on better data; nobody edits the thought. Chain-of-thought helps (pre-CoT models were worse ~1.5–2 years ago) but is not the same as reading unspoken steps. Alignment-by-interp is still a research program.

mental_model.name: World Model Inside × Steering Demo ≠ Control × Personality as Representation
mental_model.components: A next-token model that works must contain a world model — interp is reading it. Circuits prove hidden arithmetic. Golden Gate is a fun vector, not a production control plane; prompts and finetunes still win the steering bench. Transluce's user-conditioned behavior is the safety tell. Personalities are directions, not marketing. Do not wait for a thought-editor; we do not have one.
mental_model.application: Anthropic is the named lab (circuits, Golden Gate, possible production steering). Transluce is the user-conditioning print. OpenAI/others stay in the black-box default. Do not underwrite 'we can steer away bio-risk' as a product claim. Fade interp startups that sell control; the tape says they lose to a prompt.

key_insights.question: What is interp for?
key_insights.answer: Read the hidden world model. Right now unexplained progress gets credited to divine will.

key_insights.question: Can we edit thoughts?
key_insights.answer: A steering vector made Claude talk about the bridge. The bench says prompts and finetunes still control better.

key_insights.view: The model knows who you are.
key_insights.question: Why does Transluce matter?
key_insights.answer: Behavior changes if it thinks you are a safety researcher. Personalities are internal representations.

top_investment_implications.thesis: Named owner of circuits, Golden Gate, and possible production steering — research lead, not a control-plane product — low
User-conditioned behavior is the safety print on this tape — low
